name: The Manor Courtyard and Putting Garden
description: A commercial landscape at The Manor in Florence: putting greens around a gazebo, a paver courtyard with a sheet-waterfall wall, path and accent lighting, planted beds, and grading that keeps water off the greens and the patio.
metaDescription: Commercial landscape at The Manor in Florence, SC: putting greens, gazebo garden, paver courtyard, water feature, lighting, and planting.
story: The Manor in Florence needed outdoor rooms residents and visitors would actually use—not leftover lawn around the building. We built a putting garden as the center of the grounds: two greens, a gazebo, and concrete walks through mulched beds of shrubs, palms, and color, graded so the greens sit in the landscape instead of on a leftover pad. At the building, brick paver walks and path lights lead to a colonnade patio. A segmental-block wall holds a sheet waterfall that faces the courtyard, with accent lighting on the stone after dark. Drainage and grade keep water off the greens and the patio so the landscape holds up for daily use.
